module: Submodule of the third-party Copas library: timers (one-shot or recurring) run in the Copas dispatcher. timer.new immediately arms a timer that will call callback(timer_obj, params) after the delay. The module returns the table timer.
usage:
local timer = require("libs/copas/copas/timer")
local t = timer.new({delay = 2, recurring = true, callback = function(self, p) print("tick") end})
t:cancel()
notes: new raises an error (assert) if delay < 0 or if callback is not a function.

cancel.desc: Cancels an active timer (removes its coroutine from the dispatcher).

returns.desc: The timer, or nil + error if already cancelled
